entities.name: Thirty Years' War
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The most destructive conflict in European history before WWI (1618–1648), initially a religious war between Catholic and Protestant states within the Holy Roman Empire that grew into a continental power struggle. The Peace of Westphalia established the modern concept of national sovereignty.
